title: Edge case — no ranking declared
description: The document declares no rankings and carries no rank. A consumer must still order it, using the implicit ranking: the first measure whose betterWhen is not none, standard tie handling, non-rankable statuses excluded. The average heart rate is measured and never ranked, so the implicit ranking skips it and settles on the time. The bib is an attribute, not a measure: it is allocated rather than observed (spec §5.3.5).
